tasks.title: Вопросы 6-8: Пещера в карбонатных породах
tasks.statement:
In Thailand, a small cave is discovered inside carbonate rock. It is located right at a river bed. The floor of the cave is covered with water and is off about several centimeters thick; the maximum height of the ceiling is approximately 3.5 meters. During the wet season, the cave floor is about 20 meters higher than the coast line area level. During the dry season, the difference between the levels increased about 25 meters.
The characteristic shapes of the cave, including stalactites, stalagmites and other (speleothems) cave soil can be observed. Breathing is easy near the entrance of the cave; however, 60 meters from the entrance of the cave, air in a, it becomes both difficult to walk and to breathe. Breathing becomes almost impossible near the cave floor due to the presence of a certain gas. The concentration of this gas seems to increase from the ceiling to the floor of the cave.
A simple method was used to identify this gas, and there is a phase of found:
(i) You can light a lighter flame near the cave floor. But when you can light it easily near the ceiling, the flame burns well.
(ii) When the lit lighter is moved down toward the ground, the flame tends to move away from the lighter. The distance between the lighter and the flame gradually increases as you approach the ground. Eventually the flame goes off at ground level.
